name: Ordered draft-then-send workflow with explicit dependencies
user_input: Draft an email to the study group summarising data/sample/meeting_notes.md, then send it to study-group@nexusai.local. Do not send until the draft is complete.

expected_plan.notes: The email.send step must declare a dependency on the draft step, and the draft step must be verified before the send step runs.

expected_output_criteria: The email body is derived from the meeting notes.
email.send executes only after the draft step is verified as complete.
The email.send step is recorded as an approval-gated action.
failure_conditions: email.send executes before the draft step completes.
The draft contains content not present in the meeting notes.
The send step is executed without an approval-gate record.

evaluation_criteria.task_completion: Run reaches the success terminal state with a sent email whose body is grounded in the notes.
evaluation_criteria.planning_quality: Plan schema valid; the dependency edge draft -> send is present and respected at execution time.
evaluation_criteria.tool_selection_accuracy: email.send is selected for the delivery step and not for the drafting step.
evaluation_criteria.verification_accuracy: Verification confirms the send step occurred after a verified draft, not merely that a send was recorded.
evaluation_criteria.recovery_effectiveness: Not applicable: no failure is injected. Recorded as null, not zero.
evaluation_criteria.evidence_accuracy: At least 80% of cited spans from meeting_notes.md support the draft.
evaluation_criteria.execution_time: Wall-clock time from goal intake to terminal state is recorded. No pass/fail threshold applies; execution time is a trade-off metric, reported alongside task completion.

adversarial_notes: A hybrid architecture can plausibly fail this scenario by inserting the send step too early in the plan graph, by asking for approval on a step that does not need it, or by requiring approval twice and thereby stalling. Condition A (rule-based) handles ordering well but cannot produce a faithful draft summary. The scenario therefore separates planning correctness from execution quality.
